name: Andrew
summary: A fisherman, the brother of Simon Peter, who heard John the Baptist speak and followed Jesus. He brought his brother to Jesus and became one of the twelve apostles.

key_moments.title: Bringing His Brother
key_moments.description: Andrew heard John call Jesus the Lamb of God and followed Jesus. Then he found his brother Simon, told him they had found the Messiah, and brought him to Jesus.

key_moments.title: Called to Be a Fisher of Men
key_moments.description: Jesus saw Andrew and Simon throwing a net into the sea of Galilee. He told them to follow Him and He would make them fishers of men, and they left their nets at once.

key_moments.title: Points Out a Boy with Five Loaves
key_moments.description: When a great crowd needed food, Andrew told Jesus that a boy there had five loaves of barley bread and two fish, but asked what they were among so many. Jesus fed everyone with them, and twelve baskets were left over.

key_moments.title: Brings the Greeks' Request to Jesus
key_moments.description: Some Greeks asked Philip to see Jesus. Philip told Andrew, and together they went and told Jesus.
